frequency: month-end; same formation panel and ex-ante eligibility as profitability
rank_percentile: (average_rank - 0.5) / N, on each dimension's eligible complete-case universe
score: 100 * equal-weight mean of direction-adjusted component percentiles
missing_policy: all listed components required; no zero imputation or reweighting

profitability.label: Profitabilnost
profitability.status: existing four-component profitability bundle, reproduced unchanged
profitability.interpretation: Higher profitability; original complete-four universe, including the narrower FF annual input.

earnings_quality.label: Kvaliteta dobiti
earnings_quality.status: project composite; not an exact Sloan or S&P replication
earnings_quality.interpretation: Lower cash-flow accruals, operating accruals and net operating assets relative to total assets.

financial_safety.label: Financijska sigurnost
financial_safety.status: fundamental safety proxy; no beta, bankruptcy probability or sector adjustment
financial_safety.interpretation: Lower debt and near-term refinancing pressure, higher interest coverage. Undefined coverage for debt-free firms remains missing.

earnings_stability.label: Stabilnost poslovanja
earnings_stability.status: existing 20-quarter earnings, CFO and sales volatility measures; not QMJ ROE volatility
earnings_stability.interpretation: Lower volatility of quarterly earnings, CFO and sales over a contiguous 20-quarter grid, at least 12 finite observations; scaled by current average assets. Stability does not imply positive profits.

quality_growth.label: Rast profitabilnosti — 5Y proxy
quality_growth.status: five-year changes in observed profitability ratios; not QMJ residual per-share growth
quality_growth.interpretation: Current ratio minus the same security's ratio at the formation month exactly 60 calendar months earlier; no substitution with sales growth or shorter history.

investment_discipline.label: Investicijska disciplina
investment_discipline.status: conservative investment proxy; low investment is not necessarily optimal investment
investment_discipline.interpretation: Lower one-year asset growth and lower increase in PPE plus inventory divided by lagged assets.

payout_dilution.label: Payout i razrjeđivanje
payout_dilution.status: cash payout and reported share-growth proxy; includes valuation through market-cap denominators
payout_dilution.interpretation: Higher cash dividend yield, lower net cash equity issuance and lower reported share-count growth. Vendor share bases and splits remain limitations. Missing dividends are not assumed zero.

profitability_broad.label: Profitabilnost — široki 3
profitability_broad.interpretation: Broader universe without the annual FF input; not substituted for the original four-component indicator.

excluded_after_input_audit.FUND_WORKING_CAPITAL_ACCRUALS_YOY: Only about 0.1% eligible coverage in 2007, 2012 and 2020; do not restrict the main earnings-quality history to this field.
excluded_after_input_audit.FUND_CFO_CONVERSION_TTM: CFO/net income can misrank loss-making firms and is unstable near zero earnings; not used in the main composite.
excluded_after_input_audit.FUND_DEBT_PAYDOWN_YIELD_TTM: Only about 0.2% eligible coverage in 2007; omitted rather than changing the payout formula over time.
excluded_after_input_audit.FUND_REPURCHASE_YIELD_TTM: Exact negative of net equity issuance yield; including both would double-count the same input.
excluded_after_input_audit.FUND_SHAREHOLDER_YIELD_TTM: Sum of dividend and repurchase yield; do not add to its own constituents.
